title: Browser keeps retrying the live socket and never gives up (G-9-2)
reference_behaviour: The browser keeps retrying at the capped delay, every 5 s while the device reports offline, with no point where it stops (bundle-findings 6.1).
ours: Built in bf59ec1f as REQ-113 AC-11: the browser keeps retrying at the 30 s cap with no attempt limit (frontend/src/composables/useStrategyLive.js, schedule). Was: gave up after 40 attempts (about 10 minutes). Offline half also built: while navigator.onLine is false the wait is 5 s (frontend/src/composables/useStrategyLive.js:26,103) and the online event retries at once (:111); test reconnect-offline.test.js.
